The '''Skyhook Platform''' was a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] model manufactured by [[Core Worlds Engineering/Legends|Core Worlds Engineering]]. [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor's]] ''[[Falleen's Fist]]'' was a Core Worlds Engineering Skyhook Platform [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="SotES" />
